verdicts.evidence: lines 743-769: filter, clear, pager, refresh, retry, row actions (paid, reminder, undo, retry, dismiss, delete) and both dialog buttons all have listeners that call the api or re-render; panel buttons wired at 488
lines 581-584: all rows come from api.listInvoices; counts computed from state.invoices (474, 507); 'Updated' time is the real load time (515); no hardcoded figures or placeholder text
lines 698-699: the delete confirmation shows the invoice number, customer and amount it concerns, so the decision does not rely on memory of the row
line 159: one search input and a status filter, no multi-step task or long free text. (Search, status and page are kept in the URL anyway, lines 302-304, 373-381)
lines 224, 705: dialog focus starts on 'Keep draft', so Enter does not delete; status filter defaults to All (303); no risky preselected values
lines 425-427, 761: Mark paid and Send reminder are single in-row buttons with no dialog; search and overdue filter are on the same screen (159, 165)

lines 156-213: search, status filter, table, row actions and pager map to the brief. Refresh with 'Updated' time (182-185) and Sent/Paid filters are small additions that support finding and keeping overdue data current; no stat cards or panels

lines 42-51: every button is outlined/plain; no filled primary style exists. Only the one pressed status toggle is filled (64). Dialog has plain 'Keep draft' and outlined danger 'Delete draft' (224-225)
lines 50, 225, 429: delete is a red outlined button, never filled; focus goes to 'Keep draft' (705) so Enter does not delete; Delete appears only on draft rows, apart from Mark paid and Send reminder

lines 566-568: Previous/Next disabled at the ends with 'Page 1 of 2' text between them giving the reason; Keep draft disabled only while delete is in flight beside 'Deleting...' (714-716); unusable row actions are absent (425-432)
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script
lines 152-226, 264-283, 523-549: visible text is headings, labels, statuses, counts and task messages only; nothing about implementation, mock data or the request
line 699: the only caveat, 'A deleted draft cannot be restored.', sits in the delete confirmation at the point of decision; no banners, tips or disclaimers elsewhere
lines 158, 537: no text narrates the interface; the only prose is the label 'Search by customer or invoice number' and the empty-state line 'New invoices appear here once they are created.'

lines 698-699: dialog title says 'Permanently delete draft X?' and the body repeats the point as 'A deleted draft cannot be restored.', though the body also adds customer and amount. First reading fail, second reading pass
lines 152, 264-283, 523-549, 698-734: heading 'Invoices', factual messages, no greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks

lines 175, 180, 184, 224-225, 416-429, 547-549: Mark paid, Send reminder, Delete, Undo, Try again, Dismiss, Refresh, Show all invoices, Keep draft, Delete draft. Non-verb labels are only filter toggles (164-168) and Previous/Next page (210-212)
line 264: enum values mapped to Draft, Sent, Paid, Overdue; internal ids (inv_9000) never rendered, only the invoice number (441); dates and money formatted en-GB (312-328)

lines 268, 277, 523, 594, 721: 'Could not load invoices. Check your connection, then try again.', 'Could not mark as paid. The invoice is unchanged.' etc, each with a Try again button; the raw ECONNRESET text is never shown
lines 268, 277, 523, 594, 721: all errors use 'Could not ...' phrasing; no 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', capitals or exclamation marks in visible text

line 537: zero invoices shows 'No invoices yet.' and 'New invoices appear here once they are created.' with no button in the panel; the only action on screen is Refresh above it (184, 514). Brief has no create task. Readings differed

lines 523, 537, 545-549: load failure 'Could not load invoices...' with Try again; nothing exists 'No invoices yet.'; filter miss 'No overdue invoices match "x".' with 'Search all statuses' or 'Show all invoices'

lines 522-523: failed load replaces table with message and Try again; failed refresh keeps rows and shows inline error with retry (594-595); row action failure shown in row with Try again (420-423); delete failure in dialog (721-724)

lines 189, 525: 'Loading invoices...' from first paint; 'Refreshing...' (516); row shows 'Marking as paid...' / 'Sending reminder...' (418); 'Deleting...' (714). Calls take at most 1.5s so no progress or cancel needed
lines 474-475, 519-527: while invoices is null the filter counts are blank, the count line is empty and the panel shows 'Loading invoices...'; the empty state is only reached after data arrives (534)

lines 81, 92, 111-112: fixed table layout, customer wraps anywhere, dialog text wraps; amounts nowrap in 136px column; 25-row pages (261); missing number, customer, date, amount render '-' (318, 327, 441-442). Dialog body (699) would not guard a missing customer
No editable fields saved by an explicit action. (Pending mark-paid and reminder holds do trigger a beforeunload prompt, lines 776-780)
line 159: the only field is a free-text search with no format constraint
line 159: one search field, no required/optional distinction
No input validation anywhere; search filters as typed (745) and shows no errors
The search form cannot reject input (743-745)
The search form cannot be rejected by client or server (743-745)
The search form cannot reject input (743-745)
lines 156-171: the only form is the search form and it has no submit button
lines 156-171: the only form is a client-side filter. (Row actions and delete do guard repeats: 640, 652, 661, 710)

lines 642-645: a row action immediately swaps the row to 'Marking as paid' + Undo; filters re-render synchronously (605-611); Refresh label becomes 'Refreshing...' (516); Delete opens the dialog (704) and then shows 'Deleting...' (714)

lines 668-675: paid row updates in place and stays pinned, counts refresh; reminder shows 'Reminder sent <date>' in the status cell (394-397); delete removes the row and states 'Draft X deleted.' (734); failures shown in row or dialog (421, 721)

line 734: the only visible success message is 'Draft X deleted.', which reports a removal otherwise shown only by an absent row; mark paid and reminder show no visible success message, only the changed row (announce is screen-reader only, 675)

Errors persist until retried or dismissed (420-423, 594-595, 721). But the 'Marking as paid / Undo' row state carries an action and disappears on a 6 second timer (262, 643). Unclear whether a held-commit undo counts as a transient message
lines 639-657: Mark paid and Send reminder run with no confirmation dialog and offer an in-row Undo for 6 seconds before the request is sent (262, 416, 643)

lines 698-705: 'Permanently delete draft NW-x?' with customer, amount and 'A deleted draft cannot be restored.', buttons 'Keep draft' / 'Delete draft', focus on Keep draft. Reminders are held 6s with Undo instead of a prompt (643)
lines 693-706, 765: the only confirmation dialog guards permanent deletion of a draft; mark paid, reminder, refresh and filters have none
lines 659-681, 717-733: no optimistic updates; status and row removal change only after the server call resolves, the hold and sending phases show a pending label instead
lines 219-227, 693-706: the single modal is a one-decision delete confirmation opened only by the user's Delete click

lines 704-705: native dialog opened with showModal(), focus set to Keep draft; Escape closes unless a delete is in flight (770); native close returns focus to the trigger, and after a delete focus is moved to the next row (735-738); visible Keep draft button
lines 152-207: heading, then search and status filter, a one-line count, then the invoice table; nothing decorative precedes or outweighs the table
lines 151-171: h1 'Invoices' followed directly by the search and filter; no hero, greeting or intro panel

lines 164-168, 474-475, 508: the only summary numbers are the per-status counts inside the filter buttons and the result count line, which tell the user how many overdue or matching invoices there are to work through

lines 494-508, 557: count line reads e.g. '12 overdue invoices matching "acme", oldest due date first'; pressed status toggle is visible (64); 'Show all invoices' appears whenever a filter or search is active (180, 557)

lines 159-225, 402: all controls are native buttons, a native input and a native dialog; focus is restored after row re-render (459-466), page change (628), delete (735-738) and panel swaps (491, 559)

lines 388, 392: status is always text ('Overdue' badge, Draft, Sent, Paid); errors are worded (421, 594); the active filter is filled, bold, aria-pressed and named in the count line (64, 496); delete button carries the word Delete

line 179: the result count #count has no live role and viewChanged (605-611) never calls announce, so count changes from search or filter are silent unless empty. Row and refresh errors also go to a polite role=status region (217, 596, 680), not role=alert
No accordions, menus, comboboxes or tabs; status toggles use aria-pressed (164-168, 473) and nothing expands or collapses

lines 118-143: under 800px rows become grid cards with number, amount, customer, due, status and actions; buttons and input are 44px tall; filters wrap (61); dialog is min(440px, 100vw - 32px) with wrapping buttons (107, 115)
